description: We are looking for an experienced Scripting & Automation Engineer to lead the modernization of legacy backend scripts, automation workflows, and data pipelines. Automated Testing Strategy: Build comprehensive unit and integration tests (Test::More for Perl, pytest for Python) to validate feature parity between network and local execution environments. Pipeline & Workflow Updates: Reconfigure Windows Scheduled Tasks, CI/CD pipelines, and PowerShell build scripts to execute scripts and tools natively on local disk storage. End-to-End Delivery: Take ownership of migrating legacy scripts, automation flows, and backend tasks from initial network path analysis through local verification and production rollout. Required Qualifications 3–5 years of hands-on software development and automation experience with Perl and Python in a Windows environment. Strong knowledge of Windows file systems (NTFS), network pathing mechanics (UNC format vs. local paths), process execution, and environment variables. Practical experience using AI coding assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate code conversion, script generation, and refactoring. Deep understanding of dependency management tools across both stacks (CPAN, local::lib, Carton, pip, venv, poetry, uv). Communicate technical solutions and progress effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Minimum of 8 years of professional software engineering experience designing and building scalable backend systems and cloud-native applications. Strong experience developing applications using C# and modern .NET. Strong experience designing cloud-native applications using AWS and serverless architectures. Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architecture. Strong experience designing and developing event-driven applications using messaging and event streaming technologies such as Amazon EventBridge, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Amazon SQS/SNS, or similar. Experience designing and developing reusable backend services, RESTful APIs, and system integrations. Experience building workflow automation, business process orchestration, or event-driven business applications. Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases, including data modelling and performance optimisation. Experience defining and maintaining cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code, with practical experience of AWS CloudFormation. Good understanding of Kubernetes and modern cloud deployment environments. Experience implementing monitoring, logging, and observability practices for production systems. Strong understanding of secure software development principles and cloud security best practices. Experience designing highly available, resilient, business-critical software systems. Ability to analyse complex business processes and design scalable software solutions that automate workflows and improve operational efficiency. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills. Strong communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills. Nice to Have Experience within financial services, payments, banking, or other regulated industries.
